cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a tiny neighborhood repair cafe with a sunlit workbench and a hand-cranked mechanical ticket dispenser — she frees a jammed paper roll from the dispenser using two wooden clothes pegs; a dim jazz bar with a grand piano — standing; a quiet seaside tidal-rock bathing terrace with shallow clear pools — she uses a small floating balance to divide smooth pebbles into equal piles; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — sitting on the ground; an empty sunny laundromat folding counter beside a large round washing-machine door — she compares two freshly paired socks by folding them into equal rectangles; a bus shelter on a quiet street — kneeling on one knee; a clear spring glowing with soft blue light in a mossy grotto — chest-deep in the water; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds a wooden practice sword point-down at her side; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — seated on a chair
